distributive_law_lambda.name: distributive_law_lambda
distributive_law_lambda.description: The distributive law λ: PG → GP as the mixed distributive law mediating the power-set monad P (Cantor diagonalization) and Gödel encoding comonad G, with ⊙ as the fixed point of λ — the grammar's self-encoding formula g := Cantor ∘ Gödel realized categorically.

monad_cantor.name: monad_cantor
monad_cantor.description: Cantor power-set monad P: unit η:Id→P, μ:PP→P (union). Upward-overflow half of λ without comonad δ; imscriptive cardinals D_omega, containment T_invscr, categorical R_ctz, P_pipevar (no Frobenius δ), F_hardsign all-subsets, K_schwa iterative, G_revapostrophe all-objects, Gamma_doublevertline union, Phi_ctyogh inaccessible boundary, H_invscripta infinite, S_ltailm, Omega_dzlig hierarchy.

comonad_goedel.name: comonad_goedel
comonad_goedel.description: The Gödel encoding comonad alone, without the monad structure. The comonad G has counit ε: G → Id (Gödel numbering decodes back to sentences) and comultiplication δ: G → GG (the encoding hierarchy nests — Gödel numbering of Gödel numberings). This is the downward-embedding half of λ.

self-reading_fixed_point.name: self-reading_fixed_point
self-reading_fixed_point.description: Self-reading fixed point - The numeral is its own decomposition: reading it and factoring it are the same act, as in a quine whose source is its output. The fixed point lives in the closure of Y on a pairing that is simultaneously multiplicative, a self-referential object

dual-named_numerals.name: dual-named_numerals
dual-named_numerals.description: Dual-named numerals - Let a numeral be a pair (name, shape), where the name is N and the shape is the two-point space Spec(Z/N) = {p, q}. Reading off the factors is evaluation at the points, the way you read a coordinate off a vector. Under CRT the numerals native form is Z/p × Z/q, and “N” is just the label on its quotient. Nothing is searched, because the numeral never exists without its legs
